gaps.lead: 'I've never been to Asia,' she told me.
gaps.sentence: She told me that ___ to Asia.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect shifts to past perfect in reported speech.

gaps.lead: Journalists allege that the mayor accepted bribes.
gaps.explanation: 'They allege that he did' becomes 'he is alleged to have done' — passive reporting.

gaps.lead: They have accused the mayor of corruption.
gaps.explanation: Active 'they have accused him of' becomes passive: has been accused of.

gaps.lead: She speaks French better than her brother does.
gaps.explanation: 'Doesn't speak French as well as' reverses the comparison.

gaps.lead: This is the best coffee I've ever tasted.
gaps.explanation: 'The best I've ever tasted' → 'never tasted better'.

gaps.lead: Given that he has no experience, will Glyn be able to do this job?
gaps.sentence: Will Glyn's ___ his ability to do this job?
gaps.hint: no experience = lack of experience (noun subject)
gaps.explanation: The noun subject 'lack of experience' takes the verb 'affect'.
